note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classifications). The Evangelical Lutheran Church of Finland and the Orthodox Church have a special legal status as national churches, classed here as official_religion with full religious freedom. Military service was compulsory for men. Finland operated nuclear power plants alongside fossil, hydro and biomass generation, so energy is classed as an energy mix. Healthcare is a tax-funded municipal public system, classed as a national health service. Immigration and healthcare classifications are gameplay judgements.
